class.name: BitmapFont
class.brief_description: Renders text using fonts under the [url=https://www.angelcode.com/products/bmfont/]BMFont[/url] format. Handles files with the [code].fnt[/code] extension.
class.description: Renders text using [code]*.fnt[/code] fonts containing texture atlases. Supports distance fields. For using vector font files like TTF directly, see [DynamicFont].

method.name: add_char
method.description: Adds a character to the font, where [code]character[/code] is the Unicode value. The [code]texture_index[/code] is the index of the texture page, [code]bounding_box[/code] is the region containing the character image in the texture, [code]offset[/code] is the amount the character image needs to be offset to align the character properly, and [code]advance[/code] is how much the typeface should be advanced after drawing the character.

method.name: add_kerning_pair
method.description: Adds a kerning pair to this [BitmapFont]. Kerning adjusts the typeface advance between two specific characters. It is the difference between a standard typeface advance and the desired advance between the [code]first_character[/code] and the [code]second_character[/code].

method.name: add_texture
method.description: Adds a font atlas texture to this [BitmapFont].

method.name: clear
method.description: Clears all the font data and settings.

method.name: create_from_fnt
method.description: Creates a BitmapFont from the [code]*.fnt[/code] file at [code]path[/code].

method.name: get_kerning_pair
method.description: Returns the kerning between the [code]first_character[/code] and the [code]second_character[/code]. Kerning is the difference between a standard typeface advance and the desired advance between this pair of characters.

method.name: get_texture_count
method.description: Returns the number of font atlas textures in this [BitmapFont].

members.member: The number of pixels this [BitmapFont] reaches above the baseline.
